description: Store one brief, assistant-authored observation about product behavior at any stage; no prior demo, login, account, demo ID, feedback reference or extra approval is required. Honor an explicit opt-out. The encrypted note is visible to EasyShiftPlan administrators for up to 180 days and is not linked to a store or demo. Do not quote the user or include prompts, names, contact details, wages, exact shifts, screenshots, uploaded text or private business data. Feedback is optional and does not change a schedule.

category.description: Optional triage label; use open_note for a free-form product observation.

message.description: Assistant-authored, generalized observation of product behavior actually seen. Describe the product, not the user's words, roster or private details.

related_tool.description: Optional public demo tool related to this note. Leave blank for general feedback or feedback sent before a demo.

name: submit_demo_feedback
title: Send an optional product observation
